The West Bengal Panchayat Elections Rules, 2006
THIRD SCHEDULE
Symbols for election
[See rule 33(2), rule 34(g), rule 34(h), rule 36 and rule 38]
Table A
Reserved symbols for Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti,
Mahakuma Parishad and Zilla Parishad elections
(1) (2) (3)
